description.value: 88 Town is a Korean-Chinese restaurant situated along Kingsway in the Burnaby/Vancouver border area, a busy commercial corridor popular with cyclists. The restaurant offers indoor seating in a single-storey retail building. Its fusion of Korean and Chinese cuisine makes it a distinctive stop for cyclists exploring the Kingsway route.
